_source:
Curriculum Development Centre Teaching Module — "Physical Education and Sport Teaching Module Form 1 - Term 2" (https://library.cdcrepository.info/resource.php?id=307). Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses (Term 2) — other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: The source text contains a minor heading numbering discrepancy: Topic 6 is titled 'TOPIC: 6 GYMNASTICS', but its corresponding sub-topic is numbered '1.6.1'. General competencies were listed at the topic level in the module text, but per schema rules, only specific competencies explicitly linked to sub-topics were included in the competencies arrays.

ADDED (2026-09-08): a real 'Physical Education Form 1 Scheme of Work, Term 2' (a real Zambian secondary school's Physical Education Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) confirmed real week placement for 5 of this term's already-bundled sub-topics (1.5.2, 1.5.3, 1.6.1, 1.7.1, 1.7.2 -- now carrying real week_number values) and revealed two genuinely new Term 2 topics this app previously had no content for at all: 1.9 Sports Skills and Activity Development (Athletics/Ball games/Board games/Racquet games) and 1.10 Anatomy and Physiology (Human skeletal system), citing the same real '2024 Physical Education and Sport Syllabus, Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' (pp.19-23). Real, disclosed discrepancy, not resolved by guessing: this same real document places 1.8 Swimming's own real teaching in TERM 3 instead (see this file's Term 3 _source note) -- the original CDC Teaching Module this file's Term 2 content was built from places 1.8 Swimming in Term 2, and that placement is left exactly as it was; 1.5.1 Health-Related Components of Fitness also has no real week data from this second source and is left without one.

ADDED (2026-09-08): Term 3 built from the same real school's own 'Physical Education Scheme of Work, Term 3' document, citing the same real syllabus (pp.17, 23-24). Real, disclosed exclusion: this real document's own week 6 and week 8 both re-teach 1.8 Swimming (1.8.1 Water Safety, 1.8.2 Pool) -- the exact same sub-topics, same competency wording, already bundled under this file's own Term 2 -- so those two weeks are NOT duplicated into Term 3 here; only 1.3 Sports Facilities and Equipment.., 1.11 Sports Biomechanics, and 1.12 Entrepreneurship in Sport (this document's genuinely new Term 3 content) are included. Weeks 9-13 of this same real document are confirmed pure revision/exam weeks (REVISION/PRACTICAL ASSESSMENTS/END OF TERM TESTS, no new topic named), consistent with this app's standing rule against encoding generic revision weeks as topics. A real numbering irregularity is preserved as-is, not renumbered: '1.3 Sports Facilities and Equipment' and the Term 2 topics it sits alongside in Term 3 (1.11, 1.12) carry lower topic numbers than several already-taught Term 2 topics (1.5-1.10) -- this specific school's own real teaching order, not an error to correct.

subject.name: Physical Education
subject.description: Physical Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.5 FITNESS ACTIVITIES
topics.description: Fitness connects closely to developing overall physical, social, emotional, spiritual, and mental well-being, enabling learners to handle daily life and sports challenges efficiently. This unit introduces fundamental concepts of health-related fitness components as well as isotonic and isometric activities.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.5.1 Health-Related Components of Fitness
sub_topics.description: Focuses on the five health-related components of fitness—cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, and body composition—essential for maintaining overall physical well-being.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.5.2 Isotonic activities
sub_topics.description: Covers physical exercises where muscle length and tension change simultaneously to move joints through a range of motion under constant tension.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.5.3 Isometric Activities
sub_topics.description: Explores exercises where muscles contract and generate force statically without moving the joints or changing muscle length.

topics.name: TOPIC: 6 GYMNASTICS
topics.description: Gymnastics involves systematic and rhythmic exercises on the ground, bars, and apparatus requiring strength, flexibility, balance, coordination, agility, endurance, and control. It tests a performer's ability to control body movement while making significant contributions to overall physical education goals.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.6.1. Stunts and Tumbling activities
sub_topics.description: Focuses on tumbling acrobatic movements on the ground and stunts requiring lifting or supporting another gymnast to build dedication, self-confidence, balance, and physical fitness.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.7 RECREATIONAL GAMES AND ACTIVITIES
topics.description: Recreational games and activities are structured forms of play undertaken primarily for enjoyment, relaxation, physical fitness, and social interaction. They serve as stress relievers while fostering teamwork, leadership, strategic thinking, and cultural appreciation.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.7.1. Aerobics
sub_topics.description: Covers rhythmic body movements performed individually or in groups, with or without music, using locomotor, non-locomotor, and manipulative movement patterns.

competencies.description: Perform step and rhythmic patterns of aerobics

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.7.2. Traditional games
sub_topics.description: Examines cultural activities passed down through generations that promote socialization, physical development, critical thinking, and preservation of community heritage.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.8 SWIMMING
topics.description: Swimming covers moving through water using coordinated arm and leg movements, providing a full-body workout that builds cardiovascular endurance, strength, flexibility, and coordination. This topic focuses on fundamental swimming concepts, water safety practices, and pool hygiene.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.8.1 Water Safety
sub_topics.description: Covers safety practices, precautions, and awareness needed to prevent accidents, injuries, or drowning in various aquatic environments.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.8.2 Pool
sub_topics.description: Focuses on maintaining proper pool hygiene, safe behavior around pool areas, and sanitation practices to ensure a healthy aquatic environment.

topics.name: TOPIC: 1.9 SPORTS SKILLS AND ACTIVITY DEVELOPMENT

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.9.1 Athletics
sub_topics.description: Basic skills for track events (sprints, relays).

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.9.2 Ball games

competencies.description: Perform skills in Football and Netball games

sub_topics.description: Basic skills in Football and Netball (dribbling, passing, catching).

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.9.3 Board games

competencies.description: Perform skills in Chess and Draught

sub_topics.description: Basic rules and moves in Chess and Draughts.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.9.4 Racquet games
sub_topics.description: Basic grip, strokes, and footwork in Badminton.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.10.1 Human skeletal system
sub_topics.description: The human skeletal system: framework, functions, and types of joints.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.1 Forces
sub_topics.description: Types of forces (friction, gravity) in sports.

sub_topics.name: 1.11.2 Speed
sub_topics.description: The concept of speed in sporting activities.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.1 Sports Entrepreneurship
sub_topics.description: The role of entrepreneurship in the sports industry.

sub_topics.name: 1.12.2 Sports Industry

competencies.description: Exhibit knowledge of sectors in sports industry

sub_topics.description: Various sectors within the sports industry.

sub_topics.name: 1.3.2 Management and Maintenance of Sports Facilities and Equipment

competencies.description: Manage and maintain sports facilities and equipment

sub_topics.description: Skills for managing and maintaining sports facilities/equipment.
